# How True Love Yoga Streamlined Bookings with WellnessLiving

![How True Love Yoga Streamlined Bookings and Reduced Admin Overhead with WellnessLiving](https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/True-Love-Yoga-Blog-Cover-1024x683.webp)

Last Updated on 21 October, 2025

## A Yoga Studio Rooted in Love… and Now, in Seamless Operations

In the heart of Kansas City, **Lauren Leduc**, founder of [**True Love Yoga**](https://www.trueloveyogakc.com/), has built more than just a yoga studio — she’s created a home for accessible, inclusive, and trauma-informed yoga. With offerings ranging from **pay-what-you-can classes** to **international retreats**, Lauren’s mission is clear: make yoga a lifelong, enriching path for everyone.

But until recently, a clunky digital experience was holding her business back. Constant client confusion, broken booking widgets, and missed registrations were slowing growth and overwhelming her inbox.

That changed when Lauren migrated her business to a [**WellnessLiving Presence Custom Website**](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/build-presence-page/), a fully integrated website solution built specifically for fitness and wellness business owners.

* * *

## The Challenge: Scheduling Headaches and Lost Trust

Before switching to [WellnessLiving’s built-in tools](https://www.wellnessliving.com/yoga/software/), Lauren’s studio ran on **Squarespace** patched together with third-party booking widgets. The site looked polished — but behind the scenes, it created daily disruptions.

> “Before I was using Squarespace. Its integrated widgets often didn’t work, and that was a huge problem…. As a business owner, I was constantly getting emails and messages from clients asking, ‘how do I get on your schedule’ and things like that.”

The experience wasn’t just frustrating — it was costing time, trust, and revenue. Clients couldn’t reliably **book classes**, manage accounts, or navigate offerings like **retreats and teacher training**. Lauren needed a solution that would **integrate cleanly** with her fitness studio software, cut down on support emails, and help her serve her growing community.

* * *

## The Solution: A Fully Integrated, High-Performance Website

Lauren became an early adopter of WellnessLiving’s upgraded Elementor-powered website builder designed to give wellness businesses a **fully branded, seamless online experience**.

> “WellnessLiving really solved a lot of those earlier issues for me, which was great!”

With help from the **WellnessLiving Presence team**, the new True Love Yoga site launched in February 2025. From there, everything changed.

- **Booking tools** were more reliable and easier for clients to use.
- The site looked and felt like **an extension of Lauren’s brand**.
- **Performance** matched her business’s growing professionalism.

> “It was seamless. I had a few calls with the team. I’d give feedback, and they’d be on top of it. It was an easy process.”

Lauren now manages the site with ease, updating it herself through the **drag-and-drop** Elementor interface, or submitting quick requests to the Presence team — typically completed within 48 hours.

![True Love Yoga site with Presence](https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/True-Love-Yoga-Presence-Devices-297x300.jpg)

* * *

## Results That Matter: Fewer Emails, Happier Clients, and More Headspace

Since launching her new site, Lauren reports a dramatic drop in client confusion.

> “I’ve heard very little confusion, and I take that as a very good sign.”

Clients can now **view schedules**, **stream on-demand videos**, and **book with confidence** from a single destination. The site also seamlessly complements the [**Achieve Client App**](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/achieve/), creating a consistent, fully branded experience for both new and returning clients.

Lauren now spends less time on tech support and more time doing what matters: running programs, building community, and growing her business.

![True Love Yoga team](https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/ec4c42ff7d578e46129e577b751cda54-600x400.png)

* * *

## Favorite Features: Tools That Just Work

These are the **WellnessLiving features** Lauren uses most to support her day-to-day operations:

- **Integrated Booking Widgets** \| Drastically reduced confusion and helped clients self-serve
- **Elementor Page Builder** \| Flexible layouts allow Lauren to update her site without coding
- **Responsive Support Team** \| Major site updates requiring extra support are turned around within 48 hours.
- **Streamlined Cart Experience** \| Easier checkouts = fewer abandoned purchases
- **Client Account Access (Coming Soon)** \| Lauren’s excited for features that will let clients manage **memberships and payment methods** right from the site


* * *

## Why This Matters for Wellness Business Owners

Lauren’s journey is familiar to many business owners trying to juggle multiple disconnected systems. If your current setup feels **frustrating, limiting, or out of sync with your growth**, it may be time for a change.

> “It has so many features — but it’s not hard to use. That’s great.”

With **WellnessLiving’s all-in-one wellness business management software**, Lauren now has a platform that supports her vision, simplifies operations, and scales with her business — without sacrificing the human touch.
